title: Tech Note: Utilizing Info Report Component
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The 4D Info Report component remains a real, actively maintained third-party/community component available on TAOW and is still a commonly recommended first-step diagnostic tool for troubleshooting long-running 4D database issues; the technique described is still applicable, contingent on downloading the current version matching one's 4D release.
related_updates: The info report component (maintained by Thomas Schlumberger, distributed via TAOW) continues to be updated for newer 4D versions and remains a go-to lightweight monitoring tool
No native 4D replacement has subsumed this component's functionality; developers still install/configure it the same way described in this note for the appropriate 4D version
